$comment: DERIVED -- not verbatim. RFC 9921 defines no JSON projection and ships no JSON Schema; the projection validated here is this library's, and exists so a JSON-side tool can carry the two parameters without inventing a shape per tool. The authoritative form is CBOR: see cose-headers.derived.cddl.
title: RFC 9921 COSE header parameters, in a JSON projection

protected.description: The protected header bucket. RFC 9921 §3.2 requires 3161-ttc here.

269.description: 3161-ttc. Timestamp, Then COSE. Imprint over the payload bytes only.

unprotected.description: The unprotected header bucket. RFC 9921 §3.1 requires 3161-ctt here.

270.description: 3161-ctt. COSE, Then Timestamp. Imprint over the CBOR-encoded signature field, head included.

timestampToken.description: Lower-case base16 of the DER-encoded TimeStampToken. A CBOR bstr of major type 2 in the authoritative encoding. NOTHING HERE CHECKS THE TOKEN: RFC 9921 §6 gives Value Registry '-', and the content is a CMS SignedData (RFC 5652) whose grammar is outside both this document and this library. The only checkable facts are that it is a byte string and, as a cross-check, that it begins with the DER tag of a SEQUENCE.

x-library-provenance.not_checkable_here: the 5453 octets inside the byte string
